new_dir_readme:
# The official engine from @@PIN_SHORT@@: @@NAME@@ (R8, the catch-up with upstream's card code)

- **Programs:** `deckgym`, `legality_scan`, `goldfish`; sha256 in `SHA256SUMS` and `project_manifest.json`. Linux (WSL or the cloud). Committed with the executable bit (git mode 100755), so a Linux clone runs them as they are.
  - `deckgym` @@DECKGYM_SHA@@
  - `legality_scan` @@LEGALITY_SCAN_SHA@@
  - `goldfish` @@GOLDFISH_SHA@@
  - These are the programs R8's build made, copied and never rebuilt (`../results/r8_catchup_2026-10-29/r8_release/programs_final/`, the same git blobs; build record @@RECORD8@@).
- **Built** in WSL (@@BUILT_AT@@, 638 s) from S8, 543dad0007a345128ec95e9c2698699c8b5493ce (the tip of branch `laptop/r8-catchup-2026-10-29` after the merge of main, c76ad922, and the docs commit 543dad00), whose `engine/` tree is @@STREE12@@: `cargo build --release --locked`, `--example legality_scan`, `--example goldfish`, in the clean worktree `/home/dacz8976/lane_r8_w` at S8 with a fresh target directory (`/home/dacz8976/lane_r8_target`), CARGO_BUILD_JOBS 2, nice 19 (`../results/r8_catchup_2026-10-29/lane/lane_r8.sh`; `r8_release/logs/lane_R/build_R.log`; `r8_release/RAN_SHA256.txt` shows by sha256 that the official build's 18 replays ran these programs and that each floor piece ran this `deckgym`; the floor's coverage step ran the laptop checkout's then-official `rl/engine-2026-10-21/goldfish`, as for R6's floor2S, and R8's `goldfish` gives byte-equal coverage on the 11 floor decks). main's `engine/` is that tree, byte for byte.
- **What it is:** main-affe56e's engine (`../engine-2026-10-29/`) plus R8 (`../results/r8_catchup_2026-10-29/RELEASE_NOTES.md`):
  - **The catch-up with upstream's card code** through #439 (7aa4ef0).
  - **All 260 C1, SP1 and P-C printings are now played:** 256 Complete and 4 RulesUnverified (C1 015 Ribombee, C1 051 Jigglypuff, C1 135, C1 184). card_status: all 4,577 cards, 4,565 Complete and 12 RulesUnverified; older cards neither Complete nor RulesUnverified: 0.
  - **No real printing is refused any more.** The card-support refusal (`deckgym::card_support`: `deckgym simulate`, `optimize`, `goldfish` and the slow report) stays in the code and still stops a deck with a card the engine cannot play, but no printing in the card list is such a card now.
  - **The bot-protocol adapter** (`deckgym simulate --players proto,...`, opt-in `pdl_*` keys; `engine/docs/pdl-protocol-extensions.md`, the protocol bots and their tests in `engine/bots/`).
  - **The rule rows R8-10a to R8-10e** (R8-10a tests only; RELEASE_NOTES.md §2) **and item 11** (4c948025: every in-play type check now reads the in-play type, so Urshifu's Double Type counts; Leaf Cape and the bots' type pricing stay on the printed type: RELEASE_NOTES.md §2 and §12 item 8).
  - 43 files under `engine/src` and 33 under `engine/tests` change since affe56e8; 91 commits (70 first-parent). The suite (Lane N, cited under Evidence): 2,633 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- **Revert switches:** none new. The engine reads the same 14 `DECKGYM_*` environment variables as main-affe56e, none set by default. Set one and the program is another engine: never set one in a recorded run. R8's only new environment variable is the test-only `TEST_CARD_SUPPORT_MISSING_ATTACK`, read only in a build with the test-utils feature.
- **The players changed for the adapter and the new cards.** Four files of `engine/src/players/`: `protocol_player.rs` (new: the protocol adapter's player), `mod.rs` (which registers it), `opening_class.rs` (the new Ability variants' opening class) and `weighted_random_player.rs`.
  - km3 stays the working pilot, on both sides of the screen and the floor. Its play on the new cards has not been measured.
- **Evidence:**
  - Lane N (48dec4f5, the same engine tree): its programs have the same sha256 as the ones built from S8, so its checks are cited (coordinator-151; the five programs: deckgym, legality_scan, goldfish, card_status, card_enum_generator): the suite above; the goldfish steps (no test variable in the plain programs; the plain card-support test 1 passed); 18 identity replays, 156,520 games or deals: 15 SAME against the 08a9b3a references and the 3 known Growl-rule rows (new17_k3 8 of 8,500 deals, dev_km3_new17 7 of 8,500, 8_new_km3 1 of 16,000), all 18 equal to R6's S ("v S: SAME"); every rules page says no RULE finding.
  - The official build's own lane on S8 (`../results/r8_catchup_2026-10-29/r8_release/`): gencmp SAME, SAME; card_status as above (STATUS_CHECK OK); its 18 replays equal Lane N's.
  - The floor re-check, 12 of 12 pieces (24,960 games: the 11 deck pieces 21,120, run_screen 3,840) on S8's `deckgym`: games and coverage files byte-equal to R6's pages on S, each page equal apart from the engine path only. R8's `goldfish` gives byte-equal coverage on the 11 floor decks.
  - The self-checks on kx3's rebuild for the coming re-pin (K8 @@K8@@, kx3's six files on 48dec4f5, branch `laptop/kx3-on-r8-2026-11-04` on origin, not main; engine tree @@KTREE12@@; `/home/dacz8976/pincand_work/RR_R8_48dec4f5/strength/K8/strength`, sha256 @@KX8_SHA8@@…): km3 81b572198c04d5d1 (on strength_L, R8's km3 build) and kx3 31d638dbc818b0fa (on K8's program), equal to the pin's texts. The `rl/strength` Python suite: 1,438 tests OK.
- **Approved:** Dustin, Nov 4, 2026, at about 14:35Z, answering "Do you adopt R8 as the page lays out?" on the approval page "R8 Approval Sheet", relayed by the coordinator in coordinator-153 (verbatim): "Adopt all three": R8 adopted with nothing dropped, yes to item 11 (4c948025), and yes to the CLAUDE.md:14 goldfish line (RELEASE_NOTES.md §10, item 9). His Oct 21 words, via coordinator-072 (verbatim): "Move the slow-report program only after its replay check passes. Until then, its reports must clearly identify the old engine." and "Leave historical scoreboards and mixed-opponent comparisons alone. Revisit them only if a future decision relies on them."
- **What stays on the old engine** (not re-run, not new-engine evidence; their files are left as they are, and nothing is recomputed):
  - **The slow report, until its re-pin.** Its program stays kx3 on main-affe56e's engine (`/home/dacz8976/kx_r4/strength`, sha256 23d8a9b5…, built from `laptop/kx3-on-r6-2026-10-29` e3ddc014, engine tree cd970db6), and its pages say "kx3 (d513e37b's files, on main-affe56e)"; `make_predictions.py` counts no slow report as current. main-affe56e's engine left 55 of the 260 C1, SP1 and P-C printings unimplemented (R8 plays all 260), so until the re-pin a slow report of a deck holding one of them registers and then stops with the pinned program's card-support message (exit 2), while the official programs play it (`rl/strength/README.md`, "Unsupported cards"). It moves to K8's program only after kx3's replay check on this engine passes (Dustin, Oct 21).
  - Everything listed as on older engines in `../engine-2026-10-29/README.md` ("What stays on the old engine").
- **Known limits:** `../results/r8_catchup_2026-10-29/RELEASE_NOTES.md`, §5 (14 items).
- **History:** `../engine-2026-10-29/` (main-affe56e) and earlier are kept unchanged, with their hashes in the manifest's historical releases.
